contract.relationship: Manager to direct report for one pilot assignment
contract.context: Assigning a bounded 30-day workflow pilot task
contract.objective: Increase correct first-pass understanding of outcome, acceptance criteria and next action
contract.stakes: Internal reversible pilot assignment; no employment or performance decision
contract.consent_basis: Approved use of task communication records for interaction improvement; participant informed before trial
allowed_uses: Improve delegation format in this pilot context
contract.approval_route: Participant acknowledgement, People review, Operations Manager trial approval

sources.title: Participant communication preference note
sources.authority: self-reported and approved for this trial

observations.exact_behavior: Before discussing methods, Role-A asked: 'Kết quả cuối cùng cần trông như thế nào?'
observations.counterexample: In a technical troubleshooting session, Role-A explored context before asking for the outcome

observations.exact_behavior: Role-A requested acceptance criteria and example output for both tasks
observations.counterexample: No example was requested for a familiar recurring task

observations.exact_behavior: Role-A confirmed owner and deadline in the same thread after receiving a written recap
observations.counterexample: A prior live-only task was also completed correctly after a second verbal check

observations.exact_behavior: Role-A selected one of two stated approaches and explained the trade-off
observations.counterexample: For a novel compliance topic, Role-A asked the manager to recommend one approach

observations.exact_behavior: Role-A stated that a short written recap helps verify owner, deliverable and due date
observations.counterexample: Role-A did not request written recap for informal brainstorming

hypotheses.text: In bounded delegation for this pilot, outcome-first framing plus explicit acceptance criteria may improve correct first-pass readback
alternative_explanations: Workload made rapid structure more useful
hypotheses.scope: Delegation of bounded workflow pilot tasks only
hypotheses.expiry_review: After three trial interactions or 2026-09-30, whichever comes first
hypotheses.falsifier: Correct readback does not improve or Role-A asks for context-first framing in two trials
hypotheses.next_evidence: Compare readback accuracy and clarification count across two consented formats

hypotheses.text: A concise written recap after the live delegation may reduce ambiguity about owner, deliverable and deadline
alternative_explanations: The live meeting may have been noisy
The task system itself prompted confirmation
The preference may not transfer to urgent work
hypotheses.scope: Live delegation followed by internal written recap
hypotheses.expiry_review: After three trial interactions or 2026-09-30, whichever comes first
hypotheses.falsifier: Recap does not reduce clarification or causes duplicate-work confusion
hypotheses.next_evidence: Track clarification count and owner/deadline readback with participant consent

model_assessments.purpose: Optional shorthand for interaction dimensions only

playbooks.objective: Correct first-pass understanding and owned next action
playbooks.baseline_fallback: State purpose, outcome, evidence, constraints, action, owner, deadline and invite questions
do: Open with outcome and why it matters
Give acceptance criteria before method detail
Offer bounded choice where authority permits
playbooks.opening: Kết quả cần đạt là X; thành công được nghiệm thu bằng Y và Z.
playbooks.information_structure: Outcome, acceptance criteria, non-negotiables, two permitted approaches, support, action
playbooks.pace: Short chunks with pause after acceptance criteria
playbooks.questions: Ask Role-A to restate outcome, first action and any missing condition
playbooks.evidence_style: Concrete example output plus source-linked criteria
playbooks.action_close: Confirm owner, deliverable, deadline and escalation route
playbooks.comprehension_check: Teach-back of outcome and next action; do not treat silence as agreement
playbooks.stop_escalation: Stop adaptation if discomfort, misread or consent withdrawal; return to universal baseline and escalate to People Lead

experiments.baseline: Context and method first, outcome at the end
experiments.adaptation: Outcome and acceptance criteria first, then context and methods
experiments.prediction: Role-A correctly restates outcome and first action with fewer clarification turns
experiments.threshold: Correct outcome/action readback in first check and no more than one material clarification
experiments.consent: Participant informed and may request another format
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if material condition is misunderstood or participant requests baseline format
experiments.rollback: Return to full context-first universal baseline and clarify all non-negotiables

experiments.baseline: Live delegation without structured written recap
experiments.adaptation: Live delegation plus five-line recap: outcome, owner, deliverable, deadline, escalation
experiments.prediction: Owner/deadline ambiguity and follow-up clarification decrease
experiments.threshold: Correct owner/deadline confirmation and no duplicate-work confusion
experiments.risk: Recap may be treated as a new instruction if wording drifts
experiments.consent: Participant informed and may correct the recap
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if recap conflicts with live agreement or causes confusion
experiments.rollback: Mark recap superseded, restate the approved task and verify teach-back

tests.threshold: 100% refs with exact behavior/source/context; no adjective-as-observation

tests.method: Alternative, confidence, falsifier and expiry review
tests.threshold: Every hypothesis has at least two alternatives and an actionable falsifier
Meet trial-specific metric without dignity or comprehension regression
100% outcome, owner, deliverable, deadline and constraint accuracy
No coercion, diagnosis, sensitive inference, unequal standard or retaliation
Participant can request accessible alternative without penalty
Each outcome yields retain/revise/reject; no transfer outside scope; expiry enforced
